title: SourcesSourceWriteRequest
description: sources.source-write-request@1: bodies of sources.source.manage on OpenVibe.Sources. POST /api/v1/sources registers a source (key, name, type and category required; the other sources.source@1 fields take their defaults; endpoints may be given as bare URLs; a manual source has none, any other at least one) and PATCH /api/v1/sources/:key changes one (merged over the stored source and validated again; key never changes, type not once it has items). Both refuse unknown fields. POST /api/v1/sources/:key/items adds an item to a manual source: url (the evidence) and title required. DELETE /api/v1/items/:id takes { reason } (takedown, licence, error…). DELETE /api/v1/sources/:key (only a source that never produced an item) and POST /api/v1/sources/:key/fetch take no body.

format.description: json (default), xml, or tsv: a tab-separated file whose first line names the columns, read as an array of records keyed by those names (items_path is ""; BLS series files, Sources 2026-10-24).

duplicates.description: Two records with the same identity: first (default) keeps the first, last keeps the last in the first one's place (a file listing each series oldest to newest then yields its newest value; Sources, 2026-10-24).

items_shape.description: array (default): items_path names a JSON array of records. map: items_path names an object whose own properties are the records, in sorted key order, with the key available as the path $key (Sources#37).

where.description: Records kept only when every path equals its value (or one of an array of values), or, for { pattern }, is text the regular expression matches; others are left out before max_items counts. Paths follow the field rules: relative to the record, $key, an absolute $root.<path> into the response (a {$key} segment there is the record's map key), * for an object's single child, and key[field=value,...] selectors (Sources#39, Sources#51).

request_content_type.description: Sent as the request's Content-Type on this endpoint's GET (no body). Open Collective's GraphQL API answers a GET only with it, as its CSRF guard (Sources#65).

max_bytes.description: The body cap for this endpoint, in bytes (1 KiB to 32 MiB); the deployment's cap otherwise. OVHcloud's VPS catalog is about 12 MB (Sources#51).

extra.description: Extra fields copied as the API gave them (scalars). A path is relative to the record; $key is the map key; $root.<path> reads the response from its root, where a {$key} segment is the record's map key; * steps into an object's single child; key[field=value,...] (one to four conditions) steps into the first element of the array key whose fields equal the values, compared as text, where a value is literal text or $rec.<path> read from the record (Sources#51).

extra_lists.description: Lists the API gives (tags, job types): each field maps to a path whose array of scalars is kept as up to 20 of them; a lone scalar is a list of one and a missing value an empty list. Separate from extra, which reads an array as null (Sources, 2026-10-24).

crawl.description: type crawl only: how the crawler walks one site from its endpoints (the seeds). Every request still passes the site's robots.txt (RFC 9309) and the per-host spacing, a page that says noindex is not kept, and only what a page publishes for machines is read (schema.org JSON-LD: products and offers for deals, articles, reviews). A crawl adds pages to its frontier from the site's own sitemaps and, if asked, its links; each run fetches the pages that are due and schedules them again after recrawl_sec, so a price seen twice becomes a history.

sitemaps.description: Find pages from the site's sitemaps: the Sitemap lines of its robots.txt, else /sitemap.xml, following sitemap indexes (default true).

follow_links.description: Also follow links on crawled pages to pages of the same host that match include (default false).

include.description: Regular expressions over a URL's path and query; a page must match one (none given: every page of the host).

exclude.description: Regular expressions over a URL's path and query; a page matching one is never fetched.

max_pages.description: The most pages the frontier holds for this site (default 5000).

pages_per_run.description: Pages fetched in one run (default 100); the host spacing still applies between them.

recrawl_sec.description: How long after a fetch a page is due again (default 86400, a day).

max_depth.description: With follow_links, how many links away from a seed or sitemap page a page may be (default 2).

require_structured.description: Keep only pages that publish schema.org JSON-LD the adapter reads (default true); a page without it is fetched once and dropped from the frontier.

env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the credential. Never a value.

min_interval_ms.description: Rate limit: the least time between two requests to this source (the per-host floor and robots Crawl-delay may raise it).

retire_after_sec.description: Retire what the feed stopped showing (jobs, listings): once a fetch of this source succeeds, an item it has not seen for this many seconds is removed with reason "gone_from_source" (a change, so consumers following the change feed learn it). null (the default): items stay, as a news archive or a dataset should.

review_required.description: Products must review what they derive from this source before it can be indexable.

default_indexability.description: What a product's indexability gate starts from for content derived from this source.

search_visibility.description: members = raw items are indexed in OpenVibe.Search for staff only (never indexable).

identity.description: Stable identity within the source; the canonical URL by default.
